HOW_IT_WORKS.HERO_SUBTITLE: We've revolutionized the way you license music with our unique model that goes beyond the standard. Because we own all the rights to our music, we can offer you a worry-free experience with all rights included, globally.
HOW_IT_WORKS.BLOCKCHAIN_TITLE: Smart Contracts for Transparent Rights Management
HOW_IT_WORKS.BLOCKCHAIN_DESC: At Applisound, we leverage blockchain technology to create smart contracts that automatically manage rights, royalties, and usage permissions. This ensures complete transparency and security for both creators and clients.
HOW_IT_WORKS.SECURE_DESC: Every transaction is securely recorded on the blockchain, providing an immutable record of your music license and rights.
HOW_IT_WORKS.TRANSPARENT_DESC: Smart contracts clearly define usage rights, territories, and duration, eliminating confusion and potential disputes.
HOW_IT_WORKS.ROYALTIES_DESC: Creators receive their share of royalties automatically whenever their music is used, ensuring fair compensation.
HOW_IT_WORKS.ONLINE_DESC: With an Applisound subscription, you can use unlimited music and sound effects in your content, then publish and monetize it globally on all major platforms including YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, TikTok, podcasts, vlogs and more.
HOW_IT_WORKS.FOREVER_DESC: Simply connect your social media channels to your Applisound account to publish and monetize your content with our music, worry-free. All content published during an active subscription will stay cleared forever.
HOW_IT_WORKS.CUSTOM_TITLE: We Cover All Your Sound Needs
HOW_IT_WORKS.CUSTOM_DESC: Soundtrack anything, anywhere, with an Applisound plan. From filmmaking to game development, our customized solutions are designed to cover all of your sound personalization needs.
HOW_IT_WORKS.SIMPLIFY_DESC: Our mission is to make professional sound accessible to everyone. We've streamlined the entire process from selection to licensing, so you can focus on creating amazing content.
HOW_IT_WORKS.STEP_1_DESC: Browse our extensive library of music, sound effects, and voiceovers, or request a custom creation tailored to your specific needs.
HOW_IT_WORKS.STEP_2_DESC: Our blockchain-powered smart contracts automatically handle all licensing and rights management, giving you peace of mind.
HOW_IT_WORKS.STEP_3_DESC: Use your sounds in any project and publish anywhere, knowing that all rights are secured and properly managed.
